thread:
julie_pm: Heads-up — sketched a proposal for catalog onboarding priority buckets + customer negotiation flow. Need quick gut-check before I surface to sales/legal.

julie_pm: TL;DR: categorize incoming model requests into 3 priority buckets (Revenue-crit, Strategic, PLG/Auto), tie pin/grace rules + rollout gates to bucket, and expose a short customer negotiation checklist for pin exceptions.

alex_p: can you drop the buckets and the concrete launch gates? rough is fine.

julie_pm: sure — draft below. comments inline.

julie_pm: Bucket A — Revenue-critical (top customers or >$X/month).
- onboarding: fast-track review (48h), dedicated eng canary, SLA for pinned versions.
- pin rule: allow pin for up to 6 months, requires signed addendum + security review.
- launch gates: load test pass, eval regression < 1% vs baseline, canary 1% traffic -> 10% -> rollback window 24h.

julie_pm: Bucket B — Strategic (partner integrations, pilot contracts).
- onboarding: 1 week review, canary with feature flag.
- pin rule: exception allowed for 1-3 months, auto-review at 30d.
- launch gates: eval pass on agreed prompt set, ops runbook + monitoring hooks.

julie_pm: Bucket C — PLG / Self-serve requests.
- onboarding: normal CAT + automated evals.
- pin rule: not allowed except automated supported-vintage snapshots.
- launch gates: automated smoke + perf thresholds.

mira: This is sensible. A couple concerns: 1) How do we measure "eval regression < 1%" — policy needs a metric and dataset. 2) Legal will push back on open-ended pin durations.

samir: From CS — customers will ask for longer pins (12mo+). We should offer migration credits or dedicated migration support as a negotiation lever. Also add an explicit customer comms template for sunset windows.

alex_p: technical ask: we need explicit rollback triggers tied to observable signals, otherwise eng teams won't commit. e.g.
```
if latency_p50 > baseline*1.25 for 30m -> trigger rollback
if error_rate_increase > 0.5% absolute for 15m -> trigger canary pause
if model_quality_delta < -2% on eval_set -> initiate rollback workflow
```

julie_pm: good — i'll add those. also thinking we should require a small "compat shim" test for pinned models (backwards compat on api schema).

mira: scoreboard idea: each request gets a "pin score" computed from revenue impact, technical risk, and strategic value. if score > threshold -> Bucket A. keeps subjectivity down.

julie_pm: love that. propose initial weights: revenue x3, security risk x-2, customer_tier x2, migration_cost x-1. we can iterate.

samir: +1. also ask sales to supply the list of customers they consider "revenue-critical" so we can automate mapping.

ops-bot: CHECKLIST GENERATED: [security_review, perf_bench, canary_plan, comms_template, legal_addendum]. Please attach artifacts to the ticket.

alex_p: question on "signed addendum" — does legal want a standard TOS addendum or bespoke SOWs?

mira: legal prefers a standard addendum with optional SOW for extreme cases. we'll draft a template.

julie_pm: next steps I propose: (1) finalize pin-score formula and weights, (2) draft customer negotiation checklist & comms template, (3) prototype addendum with legal, (4) implement automated gating in console (canary toggles + rollback triggers). Aim for an internal beta next sprint.

samir: timeline's tight but doable if sales/eng allocate time. i'll coordinate with AE leads.

alex_p: engineering can implement basic rollback rules + canary toggles in 2 sprints if product writes acceptance criteria.

mira: i'll own the acceptance criteria + eval metric definition (we should pick n=3 metrics: semantic-similarity F1 on eval set, NLL delta, latency p50).

julie_pm: Great. Action items: julie -> update doc with thresholds & pin-score formula; mira -> metric defs & eval set; samir -> sales customer list; alex -> rough implementation estimate & API shape for canary/rollback controls; ops-bot -> create checklist artifact.

julie_pm: Any final concerns?

alex_p: just one — we need to log customer opt-ins/consents for pinned models (audit trail).

samir: noted. add to comms template.

mira: :thumbsup: ship it after doc update.

julie_pm: thanks all — i'll push updated doc and ping when ready for reviews.

ops-bot: TICKET CREATED -> ENG-1234 (catalog-pin-policy)

julie_pm: tagging @legal for visibility next."
